institution: Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (SCTIMST)
problem_solved: Reduced cell viability during photocrosslinking in 3D bioprinting
description: Chitra UVS GelMA is an optimized bioink formulation modified with UV-protective molecules to provide a safer microenvironment during photocrosslinking. The dried formulation can be readily solubilized in physiological solutions or cell culture media and directly combined with cells. Photocrosslinking with 365 nm UV light for less than two minutes produces a stable hydrogel that offers a non-cytotoxic 3D environment, supporting cell adhesion, migration, proliferation, and differentiation. The formulation shields cells from the harmful effects of UV exposure during crosslinking, ensuring high cell viability and functionality in 3D bioprinted constructs.
